name: WestATriageQuestionnaire
title: WEST-A Triage Questionnaire
description: Form for a WEST-A triage of an adult at the emergency department. The triage nurse measures the seven vital parameters that NEWS2 is calculated from, chooses the chief complaint, assesses the warning symptoms of its complaint algorithm, and records the needs that give yellow as the lowest priority. The vital signs are extracted as [WEST-A vital sign Observations](west-a-triage-mapping.html#vital-signs) by SDC template-based extraction; the assessment is the input of the [WEST-A Triage](PlanDefinition-west-a-triage.html) guideline, which proposes a priority. Source: the WEST-A triage manual for adults, Västra Götalandsregionen, version 2025:02:01.
purpose: Records a WEST-A triage as structured data, from which the vital sign Observations are extracted and NEWS2 and a triage priority are calculated

valueCoding.display: /min

item.text: Breaths per minute, counted over a full minute. NEWS2: 12-20 scores 0, 9-11 scores 1, 21-24 scores 2, 8 or less or 25 or more scores 3.

Peripheral oxygen saturation in %, measured with a pulse oximeter, with or without the supplemental oxygen below. Scale 1, for most patients: 96 or more scores 0, 94-95 scores 1, 92-93 scores 2, 91 or less scores 3. Use scale 2 only for known respiratory failure on a physician's order (see the assessment).

valueCoding.display: L/min

item.text: Oxygen flow the patient receives, in litres per minute. Enter 0 when the patient breathes room air. NEWS2: air scores 0, any supplemental oxygen scores 2.

valueCoding.display: mm[Hg]

item.text: Systolic pressure in mmHg. NEWS2: 111-219 scores 0, 101-110 scores 1, 91-100 scores 2, 90 or less or 220 or more scores 3.

valueCoding.display: mm[Hg]

item.text: Diastolic pressure in mmHg, measured together with the systolic pressure. NEWS2 does not score it.

valueCoding.display: /min

item.text: Beats per minute. Enter the heart rate when it is measured (ECG or auscultation), otherwise the pulse. NEWS2: 51-90 scores 0, 41-50 or 91-110 scores 1, 111-130 scores 2, 40 or less or 131 or more scores 3.
Alert, new Confusion, responds to Voice, responds to Pain, or Unresponsive. NEWS2: alert scores 0, anything else scores 3. Choose C only for confusion that is new.

valueCoding.display: Cel

item.text: Temperature in °C, to one decimal. NEWS2: 36.1-38.0 scores 0, 35.1-36.0 or 38.1-39.0 scores 1, 39.1 or more scores 2, 35.0 or less scores 3.
The main reason the patient seeks care. Each chief complaint is one WEST-A complaint algorithm, with its own red, orange and yellow warning symptoms.

Tick every warning symptom (varningssymtom) of the complaint algorithm that the patient has; the most urgent one gives the priority. Tick No warning symptoms when none of them applies. Tick the needs and processes that apply: each gives yellow (Gul) as the lowest priority.

item.text: Priority of the warning symptoms (manual override)

Optional. Choose a colour only when the triage criteria above do not express the urgency of the warning symptoms, such as for a warning symptom that is not coded: the guideline takes the more urgent of this colour and the triage criteria, so it never lowers their priority.
Frail elderly patient (sköra äldre, WEST-A p. 46): gives yellow (Gul) as the lowest priority.
The patient will probably be admitted (trolig inläggning, WEST-A p. 47): gives yellow (Gul) as the lowest priority.
The patient has been exposed to violence or sexual assault (WEST-A p. 48): gives yellow (Gul) as the lowest priority.
Only for a patient with known respiratory failure (hypercapnia), on a physician's order: NEWS2 then scores the oxygen saturation on scale 2, where 88-92% scores 0.
